svg.font-family: 'LP2P Inter', Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Architecture: on each device, a page uses the Local Peer-to-Peer API; the browser holds the picker and prompts, the local trust store, known peers and per-site grants; a transport binding (the Open Screen Network Protocol today, WebTransport with SETTLE anticipated) carries the sessions. Pages on two devices share one authenticated session for one origin.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: API boundary: no addresses, keys or discovery results cross
